Question 4
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with velocity v(t)=14t−t2, where t>0 is the time. If the particle is at the position x=−7 when t=3, calculate the position x of the particle at time t.

a
x(t)=18t2−13t3+4
b
x(t)=18t2−13t3+78
c
x(t)=18t2−13t3+1
d
x(t)=18t2−13t3−638
e
x(t)=14−2t
Submit
